syllabus_topics: Machines with continuous transport, electric trucks, elevators, compressing appliances, smithy-press and metal cutting machines and machines and appliances in the chemistry electrical equipment
teaching_methods: Laboratory exercises (using actual industrial models with real electric equipment)

assessment_methods.method: Oral introductory control at the beginning of each exercise
Oral examination on topics from the questionnaire

assessment_rules: Students who have shown unsatisfactory knowledge in the oral introductory control cannot attend the laboratory exercise. The exam includes a written part consisting of two questions and an oral examination on topics from the questionnaire.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
